knobs.note: BH-9502: the lane posts only this many days after the later close of the gate issues (#9441 scope item 6: 'Fourteen days after'). Read by bin/size-remeasure.sh as ${SIZE_REMEASURE_DELAY_DAYS:-14}.
BH-9502: the window of both tables: bin/split-chain-report.sh --days <this> and the build dirs whose deciding file is this recent. Read by bin/size-remeasure.sh as ${SIZE_REMEASURE_WINDOW_DAYS:-14}.
BH-9502: the first bucket edge ('under 600'). The three edges must ascend; a bad set falls back to 600/1200/3000 with one log line. Read by bin/size-remeasure.sh as ${SIZE_REMEASURE_EDGE_LOW:-600}.
BH-9502: the second bucket edge ('600 to 1200', both ends in). Not the size limit: the lane reads no limit and changes none. Read by bin/size-remeasure.sh as ${SIZE_REMEASURE_EDGE_MID:-1200}.
BH-9502: the third bucket edge ('1200 to 3000', 'over 3000'). Read by bin/size-remeasure.sh as ${SIZE_REMEASURE_EDGE_HIGH:-3000}.

BH-9502: space-separated issue numbers that must all be closed as completed before the delay starts ('this ticket and #9437'). Read by bin/size-remeasure.sh as ${SIZE_REMEASURE_GATE_ISSUES:-9441 9437}.
BH-9502: the issue the one comment goes on ('a comment on #6025'). Read by bin/size-remeasure.sh as ${SIZE_REMEASURE_TARGET_ISSUE:-6025}.

BH-9502: the most comment pages (100 each) read from the target thread to look for the hidden marker; a thread past it is not posted to (absence not proven). Read by bin/size-remeasure.sh as ${SIZE_REMEASURE_MAX_PAGES:-30}.
BH-9502 test seam: epoch seconds used as the clock. Read by bin/size-remeasure.sh as ${SIZE_REMEASURE_NOW:-0}; 0 means the real clock (date +%s). NOT settable from the control plane.
BH-9502 test seam: the path of the split-chain report the lane runs; empty means bin/split-chain-report.sh beside the script. An exec path, NOT settable from the control plane.
